mathematics.clock: One progress increment per15seconds; original T=15n, fixed n=4..119 for every query.
mathematics.increments: v_1..v_n form stationary AR(1), mean mu(publicq,style), scale sigma, correlation rho. Shared inverseGamma5/2 scale yields a multivariateStudent t with df5.
mathematics.endpoint: s_n=sum v_i. Its exact t5 scale^2 is sigma^2*[n+2 sum_(l=1..n-1)(n-l)rho^l].
mathematics.inference: p(n|publicq) proportional to sum_style pi_style(publicq)*t5(1; n*mu_style, endpoint_scale_style(n)); uniform n prior on original fixed domain.
mathematics.auxiliary: Conditional interiorprogress likelihood = full incrementalpath logdensity minus endpoint logdensity, styles analytically integrated. True fitn belongs only to targetlikelihood; never to prediction.

public_representation.route: Existing public projected_free seven shape residuals plus rawO,D form a ninepoint approximatepolyline. No private querypath.
public_representation.fallback: Straightline only when public routeavailability is false; no primaryrow removal.
public_representation.targets: Fit-only GPS positions project onto that publicpolyline; endpointprogress0/1, signedincrements may backtrack. This is a progressproxy, not exact roadvelocity.

risks: Approximatepublicroute can disagree with actualroute, distorting projectedprogress.
Stationary AR coefficients pertrip cannot represent every acceleration, congestion episode or independent GPS artifact.
GlobalStudent scale downweights an anomalous wholepath, not individual outlierlocations.
Conditional endpoint energy is a modelingchoice, not a guarantee of betterMAE or a physicalfirstarrival law.
RepeatedTrain reserve and one initialization give exploratoryevidence only.
